title: Correlated Gaussian density
statement: For a real correlation parameter $\rho$ with $0<\rho<1$ and real numbers $z_1,z_2$, define the correlated Gaussian density at $(z_1,z_2)$ as the standard Gaussian density at $z_1$ multiplied by the Gaussian density at $z_2$ with mean $\rho z_1$ and variance $1-\rho^2$.
